about.title: About Us
about.paragraph1: TYD Technology is a forward-thinking technology company, founded by engineers and experts who share a deep passion for innovation and automation.
about.paragraph2: We develop integrated solutions that combine artificial intelligence, automated control, and digital security — delivering flexible, sustainable, and practical products tailored to the real-world needs of modern enterprises in the Industry 4.0 era. Each of our solutions is designed with a single goal in mind: helping people work safer, smarter, and more efficiently.

ourMission.title: Our Mission

ourVision.title: Our Vision

ourCoreValues.title: Our Core Values
ourCoreValues.description: We believe that a technology company can only grow sustainably when built on the right values. Our three core principles — Innovation, Integrity, and Excellence — are the foundation of everything we do at TYD Technology.

aboutUs.ourMission: Our mission is to provide a complete solution to the needs of our customers, while ensuring that the quality of our products is always at the top of our priority list.
